title: Rav Menasheh bar Zevid
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Rav, as in the recurring formula “Rav Menasheh bar Zevid said in Rav's name” in Shevuot 45b and Menachot 108b.
Later he sat before Rav Huna, as in Yevamot 19b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Yevamot paragraph explicitly identifies Rav Huna as the person before whom he sat.

The consulted Shevuot 45b and Menachot 108b write Rav Menashya bar Zevid reporting Rav; Hyman’s Menasheh form is retained. Yevamot 19b explicitly places him before Rav Huna. The description as Rav’s student, the recurring formula, and the sequence “later” remain Hyman’s summary, not a new census or chronological admission.
